plugins.name: research-lab
plugins.description: A research lab for Claude Code: hypotheses run in a simulation environment with written requirements, an independent reviewer compares expected with actual behaviour stage by stage and turns every discrepancy into the next hypothesis, a candidate is judged once on a holdout, and a self-routing local knowledge base (hybrid search, GraphRAG, corrective RAG, contextual retrieval, reranking, incremental updates) keeps every result for later questions in any project.
